basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old gamer based in the UK, just getting into the world of Reddit and online communities. I work as a junior air traffic controller, which gives me a unique perspective on strategy and planning—skills I love applying to my gaming sessions. I’m particularly fond of FPS games like Warzone, and I’m always on the lookout for tips and tricks to improve my gameplay. Outside of gaming, I have a budding interest in constructed languages, especially Toki Pona, and I’ve been following discussions around Covid-19 in Europe. I’m single, and typically online during late evenings, after my work shifts end.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a mixed background in both technical and strategic areas. My job as a junior air traffic controller requires precise decision-making and spatial awareness, which I find translates well into gaming. I picked up gaming in college where I studied aviation management. My interest in constructed languages like Toki Pona is purely personal, sparked by an article I stumbled upon online and further explored through self-teaching resources.
